items.title: Eat a Raw Fish
items.detail: Start at Fisherman's Rest and complete 'Big Fish in a Small Pond' daily so the same catches credit both challenges

items.title: Catch a Fish
items.detail: Fast travel to Fisherman's Rest in The Mire region and use a fishing rod

items.title: Complete a Daily Quest
items.detail: Cop a Squatter Daily at Watoga Emergency Services is usually quick

items.title: Cook Grilled Fish
items.detail: Use 3 Fish Bits, 2 Salt, and 1 Wood at a Cooking Station; requires Grilled Fish recipe from Casting Off quest

items.title: Kill a Human while Wearing a Costume
items.detail: Equip any costume and fast travel to Point Pleasant to find Cultists

items.title: Kill a Spooky Scorched
items.detail: Fast travel to Morgantown Airport where Spooky Scorched reliably spawn during the event

items.title: Sell Grilled Fish to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Cook Grilled Fish first, then sell at any NPC vendor such as Whitespring Resort

items.title: Collect a Fuel Tank or Gas Canister
items.detail: Found at industrial and roadside locations like Toxic Larry's Meat 'n Go and Grafton Steel

items.title: Complete a Daily Operation!
items.detail: Easier with a team; join or start a Daily Ops public team and select from World Activity map

items.title: Craft any Plushie at a Tinkerer's Bench
items.detail: Build a Tinkerer's Bench in your C.A.M.P. or use the one at Whitespring Resort

items.title: Cripple a Spooky Scorched's Leg
items.detail: Use V.A.T.S. to target the leg at Morgantown Airport where they spawn regularly

items.title: Drink Nuka-Grape
items.detail: Get from Nuka-Cola Collectron Station in your C.A.M.P. or another player's

items.title: Drink Nuka-Orange
items.detail: Get from Nuka-Cola Collectron Station in your C.A.M.P. or another player's

items.title: Kill a Creature
items.detail: Whitespring Golf Club has dense Feral Ghoul populations that are easy to defeat

items.title: Kill a Creature while Wearing a Costume
items.detail: Equip any costume item and go to Poseidon Energy Plant for reliable Scorched spawns

items.title: Take a Chem
items.detail: Get Chems from Doctor's Orders Cigarette Machine in your C.A.M.P. or another player's

items.title: Complete a Gold Star Daily Challenge!
items.detail: Complete all six other daily challenges on three separate days during the week

events.name: Spooky Scorched
events.description: Seasonal event featuring special Halloween-themed Scorched enemies that drop mystery candy and exclusive rewards.

events.name: Night at the Morgue
events.description: Mini season event with ticket challenges that reset weekly, featuring Halloween-themed gameplay and rewards.

events.name: Seasonal Fish Run Weekend
events.description: Increased chance to catch seasonal fish during this weekend event with new recipes and challenges.

events.name: Double SCORE and Caps-A-Plenty
events.description: Earn double Scoreboard progress and increased caps from all sources.

events.name: Holiday Scorched
events.description: Winter holiday-themed variant of the Spooky Scorched event with festive rewards and gift drops.
